class Pure { fun getOnly(): String = "pure" }
fun invalid(value: Pure): String = value.only

class Child : beans.Base()
fun invalid(value: Child) { value.name = null }

class Child : beans.Base()
fun invalid(value: Child): String = value.optional

class Child : beans.Base()
fun invalid(value: Child) { value.readOnly = "new" }
